segments.rendered_text: Dacia: So my name is Dacia and I am CEO and co-founder of Supercool Earth. Our big vision at Supercool Earth is to make it rain and snow on demand. A couple years ago I was talking to a lettuce grower in Salinas Valley and he said to me, water is something that I think about every single day. I have to make a trade off between generating too much material waste or water waste. And as he was talking, I started thinking that there have to be better solutions, not just for growers, but for everybody. We need more tools in our toolbox for water. Let me add another layer to this tragedy sandwich than I'm building here. The technology for making it rain and snow already exists. It's existed for 50 years. It's called cloud seeding, and it's held back by the chemical that is used for cloud seeding. That chemical has poor activity. It is also not great for the environment. At Supercool Earth, we are building a natural product that is two times as effective as the traditional cloud seeding chemical that's used today, which means we can get two times more water out of clouds. We can target more geographies, more seasonalities. And it is compatible with the environment. Think about it like a probiotic for clouds. We are leveraging the natural mechanisms that already exist in clouds, nudging clouds to precipitate when they otherwise wouldn't, or getting more out of storms that are already going to happen.
segments.speaker: Dacia
